text:
Samir: hey all, day 2 here. Trying to run a local demo that needs Vault reads and a KMS unwrap. Quickest path to get a dev token + test key?

devex-bot: Welcome! TL;DR: open a vault-access issue with paths + manager approve for prod. For quick dev: request a 24h token or ask an engineer to create one. KMS test key requests go to #eng-security with purpose and TTL. https://redwood.internal/onboarding/secrets

Samir: what should I put in the vault-access issue body?

Alex: Put: team, repo, exact secret prefixes (e.g., secret/data/playground/*), read/write, duration (e.g., 24h dev), and manager approval (ping). Example title: "vault-access: playground - read demo creds"

Samir: can I get a token now?

Alex: I can spin up a token with policy `newhire-demo` for 24h. DMing you the token. It will include read to `secret/data/playground` only.

Samir: thanks! will verify. Also curious about rotation: if I create a demo secret wrapped with KMS, how do we rotate?

Priya: rotation summary: 1) create new key version in KMS; 2) run a rewrap (we have a job: infra/scripts/rekey.sh) to re-encrypt Vault values; 3) update service references; 4) retire old key version once traffic is on new key. For prod keys there's a ticket + owner sign-off.

Tia: @Samir approved for dev read paths. For any production access we need your service owner + security sign-off. Remember to add a note in your onboarding doc listing demo creds accessed for audit.

Samir: token works, can read the demo secret. Appreciate the fast help :thumbsup:
